objective: Replace scripted late-state supervision with independently verified corrections from actual base-model training-task states; no evaluation traces enter training.

shared_recipe.candidate_initialization: The single observed candidate starts from the identical pinned base; frozen 020 recovery is a development comparator only.

data.construction: Keep the original four inspect/repair/verify/submit records for each task (220 common records). Replace only stall_repair and late_repair (up to 110 slots) using frozen eligibility and ordering; missing eligible states retain the corresponding exact 020 recovery record. All 330 semantic IDs and one-pass seeded order remain fixed.
data.sample_selection: All 330 unique complete records. Never truncate history/targets, drop a training task, pad examples or use evaluation feedback as supervision.
data.repair_edit_operator: Python exact literal replacements with unique-anchor assertions checked before any file write; preserve ampersands/backslashes literally.
data.training_token_accounting: Equal update and upper-bound budgets; actual input and supervised token counts may differ and must be reported. No equal-token or same-FLOP claim.

state_rules.eligible: Same admitted training task; completed calls 4..8; no exit/backend error or invalid source; no protected-file violation in the prefix; actual independently graded incorrect allowed-source state.
state_rules.stall_repair: Newest eligible state with no observed allowed-source edit in its prefix. Correct its current source and independently verify the repair.
state_rules.late_repair: Prioritize states with actual current wrong edits, then unchanged states with observed nonzero tool returns, then other unresolved read-only states; newest eligible within category. Append one executed standalone declared failing test, then supervise the correct repair. Test input and failure observation must be real, not invented.
state_rules.length: Try states in the declared order, accepting the first whose whole native input is <=4096 tokens and target <=512 tokens. No clipped context or target.
state_rules.fallback: If no state satisfies all checks, retain the exact corresponding 020 recovery record and record the reason.
state_rules.coverage: Require at least 40 replaced slots across at least 20 training tasks before any new weight update; report observed wrong-edit, tool-error and read-only contributions separately.
state_rules.continuation: After <=8 sampled calls, diagnostic+repair+verification+submission must fit the original 12-call limit.
state_rules.masking: All base actions and failing diagnostics are history only; only successfully executed corrective commands are targets.

partitions.development: Same 15 observed development tasks as 019, rerun unmodified base, frozen 020 recovery and the single new candidate once under identical inference ceilings. Reused development is not independent validation.
partitions.historical: All 48 previously observed 020 final tasks, never training or selection
partitions.fresh: 24 new constructed defects, six each from four independent repository identities not used in prior training/development/evaluation; no model scores before development gate passes
partitions.fresh_repository_replacements: Only rights, runtime compatibility, actual clean/broken/restored test controls or reference exposure before any model rollout; retain exclusions. No score-based replacement.

selection.criterion: One new candidate only. Rerun base, frozen 020 recovery and new candidate once on the same 15 development tasks under identical inference ceilings.
selection.if_no_eligible_candidate: Keep final cohorts unopened; record rejection and do not upload candidate weights.

release_gate.weights_release_scope: experimental LoRA adapter plus exact base revision; full merged model only after a separate verified export, never label adapter as complete 27B weights

publication.license_policy: Original code MIT; base and training-source licenses separately preserved. No third-party teacher API outputs.

failure_policy: One 12-hour clock starts before training-task base generation and includes collection, derived-data verification/publication, training and evaluation. Freeze source/recipe/selector and heldout tasks before collection; freeze exact derived data before updates. No score reruns, extra candidate, relaxed gate or deadline extension. Infrastructure repair must preserve original evidence, exact model inputs and remaining budget.
limitations: One greedy collection rollout per training task and one training seed; this is not iterative on-policy RL.
Corrective commands come from licensed training reference snapshots, not external teacher APIs or hidden reasoning.
Some wrong or stalled states may be unavailable or exceed complete-input limits; fixed fallbacks and measured coverage must be reported.
Constructed defects, unknown pretraining contamination, repeatedly observed development tasks.
Fresh candidate repositories are Python; historical Python/JavaScript and the legacy checks retain their original scope. Repository disjointness does not imply disjoint programming concepts.
Small pilot; no broad coding, long-task, production throughput or daily-use claim.

reference_adapter.role: frozen development comparator, not an eligible release candidate

collection.tasks: all 55 admitted training tasks, sorted task ID, one rollout each
collection.snapshot: Private exact allowed-source bytes, completed history and model-input identity after each call; preserve early natural exits and errors.
collection.selection: No model score selects tasks. State choice rules and fallbacks are fixed before the first rollout.
